consequence.statement: netkit is an optional new datapath mode; veth devices remain the default and existing deployments are unaffected unless explicitly configured to use netkit.

assertion.statement: Cilium 1.16 adds netkit as a new optional datapath mode for Linux kernels 6.8 or newer, with veth remaining the default.
